_README: COPY THIS FILE to revenuecat_config.json (same folder) and paste in the real key.
revenuecat_config.json is gitignored and MUST NEVER be committed.
Where the keys come from: RevenueCat dashboard -> Project Settings -> API keys ->
the PUBLIC app-specific key for each store app. Google starts 'goog_'; Apple 'appl_'.
Public SDK keys ('goog_', 'appl_') are designed to ship inside the app binary.
SECRET keys ('sk_') must never appear in a Unity project at all - they can grant
entitlements to anyone, and an APK is not a secret.
useTestStore: set true ONLY with a RevenueCat Test Store key starting 'test_', which lets you complete
a purchase on a device with no Play Console products and no closed track. The game
refuses to use a Test Store key in a release build, because RevenueCat forbids
